application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions:
This application is currently invalid, as it is missing critical information required for the Council to understand the proposed works and make an informed decision. The tree in question is protected by a Tree Preservation Order (TPO), and the Application for Tree Works document clearly sets out the requirements needed to submit a valid application.

The Council requires the following:

A location plan clearly identifying the tree
A clear description of the proposed works, including an appropriate methodology, with the works specified in measurable terms (metres).
A justification for the works in arboricultural terms
Any relevant supporting evidence

Further details can be found within the Application for Tree Works document, to which we draw your attention.
